description: This file defines the HostEnvSanitizer utility in Swift for inspecting and sanitizing environment variable overrides based on security policies, including filtering and validation logic.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A struct representing diagnostics for environment variable override checks, including blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Analyzes a dictionary of environment variable overrides and returns diagnostics indicating which keys are blocked or invalid.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Filters and sanitizes environment variable overrides based on security policies and whether shell wrapper mode is active.
